scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Direct private-table counts and identity-aware views matched one event, three memberships, four personas, and the exact seed facts.
scenarioResults.note: A fresh database contains one deterministic event, three invitations, four development personas, the capacity fixture, and initial RSVP/post state.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Mallory’s anonymous projection contained only public fields while every protected view was empty.
scenarioResults.note: The outsider receives one anonymous public projection and no member view, private notes, guest list, RSVP, wall, asset, reminder, or attempt data.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Bob’s four RSVP transitions settled in both guest and host views with server revisions.
scenarioResults.note: Bob’s native invited identity settled maybe, yes/+1, no, and yes/+1 transitions in host and guest views.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Distinct host/cohost/guest/outsider positive and negative reducer calls were exercised by separate principals.
scenarioResults.note: Alice host, Bob cohost/guest, and Mallory outsider exercised distinct positive and negative reducer authority.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Policy changes removed and restored guest rows on Bob’s established subscription without changing the public preview.
scenarioResults.note: Guest-list policy removed and re-added rows on Bob’s already-connected subscription while the anonymous public preview stayed visible.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: A two-actor final-seat barrier committed exactly one reducer, rejected one, and direct SQL confirmed no overbooking.
scenarioResults.note: Two reducer calls contended for the final seat; ACID reducer serialization committed one and rejected one without overbooking.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Bob’s second client received twenty wall inserts and RSVP-total changes through WebSocket view callbacks without polling.
scenarioResults.note: Bob’s second client received twenty wall inserts and RSVP total transitions through generated-binding WebSocket subscriptions with no polling.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Authorized delivery preserved object identity and independently computed content hash; Mallory saw zero rows and deletion pushed.
scenarioResults.note: Native inline binary storage preserved object identity and content hash for authorized members, exposed nothing to Mallory, and pushed deletion.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: A native scheduled procedure produced one durable run and one succeeded attempt carrying the schedule dedupe key.
scenarioResults.note: A native scheduled procedure produced one inspectable reminder run and one succeeded idempotent notification attempt.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: The durable ledger suppressed a second HTTP call after known success; the deterministic receiver retained one call.
scenarioResults.note: The procedure’s durable attempt ledger suppressed a retry after known success, so the deterministic external receiver saw one delivery.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Accepted-then-dropped fault injection retained ambiguous state; retry reused the key and settled succeeded.
scenarioResults.note: The receiver accepted then dropped the first response; the ledger retained ambiguous separately, and retry reused the dedupe key and settled without a second unique delivery.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Bob’s established subscription evicted protected rows, blocked a later post, and direct SQL retained private history honestly.
scenarioResults.note: Revocation removed all protected rows from Bob’s established subscription and blocked the subsequent post while private authoritative history remained inspectable.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Official standalone identity, schema, logs, effect receipt, and local configuration are direct; hosted fields remain an explicit credential GAP.
scenarioResults.note: Official standalone target identity, schema, logs, scheduled procedure, and HTTP effect boundary are inspectable; Maincloud secret/config/deployment evidence is unavailable because no credential was provided.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Six application paths and module build retain two warmups, seven raw samples, median, nearest-rank p95, fixture, and cost scope.
scenarioResults.note: Six frozen application paths and module build each retain two warmups, seven raw samples, median, and nearest-rank p95 on the assigned isolated host.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Exact-identity deletion succeeded; positional describe returned database absence without usage diagnostics; validated processes, state, and ports are absent.
scenarioResults.note: The immutable database identity was deleted; a syntactically valid positional describe returned database absence, validated arm processes stopped, state was removed, and ports 3332/4333 closed.
